newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B climbs 5.34 pct, most traded.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B climbs 5.34 pct, most traded.

text.p: Manila Electric Corp B shares rose seven pesos, or 5.34 percent, to 138 pesos by the midsession on Wednesday as it rode high on a wave of blue-chip buying, brokers said.
"Meralco is a winner by default. In an uncertain market, the bluest and the soundest issue are the ones favoured. Meralco over time has performed well," said one foreign broker.
"Most blue chips are up except for PLDT. There's foreign buying on Meralco B," said Joey Roxas, president of Eagle Equities.
Meralco A shares also gained by mid-trade, rising by one peso to 87.50 pesos.
Meralco A shares are exclusive to local investors while Meralco B are open to foreign funds.
Meralco B was the most heavily traded issue with 854,170 issues changing hands.
